decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module still has its own dedicated page after most of the 2023 launches were dropped, which suggests it survived the firm's pruning, and keeping a distributed product listed costs a wholesaler little while demand is still uncertain.

The folding add-on unit has a documented customer installation at Kolumbus and works as a low-cost complement to the firm's Multigraf line, so the option is worth keeping open even though it is now only mentioned rather than featured.
